address: salizada Sant'Antonin, sestiere Castello 3499, Venice, 30122, Italy
bio: Founded in a different venue by an Austrian soldier in the late 19C, this historic Venetian restaurant is now run by owner Maurizio, who oversees the front of house in a courteous yet friendly manner. He introduces guests to its variety of dishes, which aim to please rather than surprise. Fish specialities are to the fore here....
